privacy.title: Privacy Policy — GROOVESTREET
privacy.description: How GROOVESTREET collects, uses and protects your information.
privacy.label: Legal
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy

sections.p: When you send us a message through our contact form we collect your name, email address and the content of your message. We do not run advertising trackers or sell your data.
We use your details only to reply to your enquiry and to deliver the work you ask for. We never add you to a marketing list without asking you first.
Enquiry messages are kept for 12 months so we can pick up a project where we left off, then deleted. You can ask us to delete your details sooner at any time.
You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you.
Questions about this policy go to the email address on our contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service — GROOVESTREET
terms.description: The terms that apply when you buy a website or design package from GROOVESTREET.
terms.label: Legal
terms.heading: Terms of Service

sections.p: Every project starts with a fixed UGX price and a written launch date. If the scope changes, we agree the new price in writing before the extra work begins.
Design rounds are included in your quote as described on the pricing page. Additional rounds are quoted separately.
We take a 50% deposit to book your start date and the balance on launch. Mobile money and bank transfer are both accepted.
Once the final invoice is settled you own the delivered work outright, including the source files and your content.
Every package includes the support window shown on the pricing page, covering fixes to work we delivered.
Questions about these terms go to the email address on our contact page.

about.title: About Us — GROOVESTREET
about.description: Meet GROOVESTREET: a design studio in Kampala where a focused team builds with AI.
about.label: About Us
about.heading: The Studio
about.subtitle: A Team, Amplified by AI
about.whoBody: GROOVESTREET is a software design agency based in Kampala, Uganda. We design and build premium websites and digital tools for growing businesses across East Africa and beyond.
about.whoBody2: We are a focused team that uses AI as a tool, not a replacement for craft. That combination lets us move faster, keep costs down, and deliver a level of polish a traditional agency structure would struggle to match.
about.howBody: Our process is simple: Discovery, Quote, Design, Build, Launch. You tell us about your business, we give you a fixed UGX quote with a written timeline, then we design, build and test on real devices before launch.
about.contactSubtitle: Tell us what you're building. We usually reply within 24 hours.
about.contactLead: Email, call or WhatsApp — whichever is easiest.

atigo.name: Atigo Paul Odoch
atigo.description: Atigo leads the studio and every client relationship. He listens, shapes the approach, and makes sure the result delivers what the quote promised.
atigo.motivation: He watched too many good businesses in Uganda stay invisible online. He built GROOVESTREET to stop that — at prices a growing business can actually pay.

josh.name: Okello Josh
josh.description: Josh builds what gets designed. He implements the sites, forms and integrations, and tests every page on real devices before it goes live.
josh.motivation: He wants technology to actually land with clients, not just work. Clean code, fast loads, and no surprises after launch.

emily.name: Ashaba Emily
emily.description: Emily designs the logos, flyers, posters and the visual side of every website. She keeps everything consistent and true to the brand.
emily.motivation: She believes good design is not a luxury but the cheapest form of advertising. A strong flyer or logo keeps working for the business while it is being held.
